QUOTE: `skipSync: true` (added path only): `sanitizeReactions` returns right after the create list is built, so it never computes `deleteReactions`. A single-reaction event therefore cannot delete other reactions on the post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says skipSync keeps a single-reaction event from deleting other reactions on the post. It also notes that without skipSync a single-reaction call would mark every other reaction for deletion.
